title: The TOSS 5 /etc/group file must be owned by root.
check_content:
Verify the ownership of the "/etc/group" file using the following command:

$ sudo stat -c "%U %n" /etc/group 

root /etc/group 

If "/etc/group" file does not have an owner of "root", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Change the owner of the file "/etc/group" to "root" using the following command:

$ sudo chown root /etc/group
VulnDiscussion: The "/etc/group" file contains information regarding groups that are configured on the system. Protecting this file is critical for system security.
